caseNameFull: Carter v. McElroy, Secretary of Defense
attorneys: Alfred Avins for petitioners. Solicitor General Rankin, Acting Assistant Attorney General Ryan, Harold H. Greene and David Rubin for respondents.

opinions.text: The motion to substitute Thomas S. Gates, Jr., in the place of Neil H. McElroy as a party respondent is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit denied.
